description:
Bulk pin or unpin an issue panel (added by a Forge app) to or from multiple projects.

The operation runs asynchronously. The response includes a task ID - use the [Get task](#api-rest-api-3-task-taskId-get) endpoint to check progress.

**[Permissions](#permissions) required:** *Administer Jira* [global permission](https://confluence.atlassian.com/x/x4dKLg).

requestBody.description: Forge module ID and the list of projects with pin or unpin action.

202.description: Accepted. Returns the task ID for polling progress.

400.description: Returned if the request body is invalid.

403.description: Returned if the user does not have permission to administer Jira.

500.description: Returned if the task could not be submitted (server error).

summary: Bulk pin or unpin issue panel to projects
